senses.gloss:
m. (-म्बः)
1 A woman's buttocks.
2 The buttocks or posteriors in general, or as it is sometimes applied, the circumference of the hip and loins.
3 The shoulder.
4 The side of a mountain.
5 A bank or shore.
E.
नि prefixed to तम्ब to go, affix अच् or तम to go, with ब aff.

f. (-नी)
A woman with large and handsome posteriors.
E.
नितम्ब as above, इनि and ङीप् aff.

ind.
1 Always, continually, eternally.
2 Especially, particularly.
E.
नि always, डतरच् comparative affix, and आम् added.

m. (-लः)
One of the seven divisions of Pātāla or hell.
E.
नि not, (known,) तल depth.

adj. mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Much, excessive.
adv. n. (-न्तं)
Much, excessively.
E.
नि prefixed to तम to desire, affix क्त, and the vowel made long.

mfn. adj. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 Eternal, everlasting, continual, perpetual; past, present, and future.
2 Regular, fixed, invariable.
n. adv. (-त्यं)
Always, eternally, continually. sub. Indispensable rite or act.
m. (-त्यः)
The ocean.
f. (-त्या)
1 A name of PĀRVATĪ.
2 The goddess MANASĀ.
3 A Śakti, a form of DURGĀ, or personified energy of ŚIVA.
E.
नि particle implying perpetually, and त्यप् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
Indispensable act or ceremony, as observance of the five great sacrifices, or any daily and necessary rite.
E.
नित्य, and कर्म्म act; also नित्यक्रिया, &c.

n. (-त्यं)
Regular and necessary act or ceremony.
E.
नित्य, and कृत्य to be done.

m. (-तिः)
Air or wind.
E.
नित्य eternal, गति motion.

f. (-ता)
Perpetuity, eternity.
E.
तल् added to नित्य; also with त्व, नित्यत्वं.

ind.
Always, constantly, and eternally.
E.
नित्य, and दाच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Daily alms.
E.
नित्य, and दान gift.

n. (-कं)
Any act or ceremony which though occasional is of regular recurrence, as Śrāddhas at fixed lunar periods.
E.
नित्य, and नैमित्तिक occasional; also नित्यनैमित्तिक कर्म्मन्.

m. (-यः)
The constant loss of living beings.
E.
नित्य, and प्रलय destruction.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Always busy or engaged in.
E.
नित्य, and युक्त attached to.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ever or always young.
m. (-ना)
A name of DRAUPADĪ.
E.
नित्य always, and यौवन youth.

ind.
Always, constantly, eternally.
E.
नित्य, and शसि aff.

m. (-मः)
An erroneous answer, one asserting perpetuity for perishable things.
E.
नित्य, and सम same.

m. (-यः)
A period when the perusal of the Vedas is invariably prohibited, as the day of full moon, new moon, the eighth and fourteenth days of the half month.
E.
नित्य always, अन् negative prefix, अध्याय to be read.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Eternal and perishable, permanent and temporary, &c.
E.
नित्य, and अनित्य transient.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well behaved, correct, modest.
2 Gained, obtained.
3 Led, conducted.
n. (-तं)
1 Wealth.
2 Corn, grain.
E.
णी to get, &c. aff. क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Given, given away.
E.
नि before, दत्त given, form irr.

f. (-ती)
1 Guiding, directing.
2 Obtaining, acquirement, acquisition.
3 Polity, political science, treating especially of the administration of government, including the practice of morality in private life, both by the sovereign and his subjects.
E.
णी to guide or gain, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-था)
Any work on polity, or good government.
E.
नीति, and कथा a tale.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Politic, conversant with government and human affairs.
E.
नीति, and कुशल able.

m. (-षः)
The car of VṚHASPATI.
E.
नीनि guiding, and घोष sound.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Knowing what is right, especially in government, sagacious, politic.
(-ज्ञः)
A statesman, a politician.
E.
नीति, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Moral, eminent for royal duties.
E.
नीति, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-द्या)
Political science.
E.
नीति, and विद्या knowledge.

n. (-स्त्रं)
The science of political ethics, or any work treating of it.
E.
नीति, and शास्त्र a scripture.

ind.
1 Having taken.
2 Having passed or spent.
E.
णी to take, क्त्वा aff.
